format: cover: series label, big title, a subtitle that says what the reader gets, 'contents' (3 or 4 part names), 'swipe': true; moving cover
spec 'parts' + 'part': n on every later slide (last slide n+1); first slide of a part labelled 'Part n · Name', the rest 'Name · what this slide is'

times rounded ('about 7:30 tonight'); Rahu/Ketu crossings given as the day; a graha within 1.5 degrees of a sign edge shows both sides or is left out
captions in the same parts with 'PART 1 · THE RULE' headers; X uses the same text without hashtags and four slides

Anger, seen. Name it, 'anger is here', and the heat drops. Mars = ego (Nadi rule bank). Gita 2.63. Picture: a flame that settles when it is seen
Who is reading this? The Sun rules the right eye, the Moon the left (Nadi rule bank, S06 karakatwa table). Kena Upanishad 1.6: that by which the eyes see. Picture: two eyes, one light behind them
You are not your chart. The chart is the field; you are the one who knows it. Gita chapter 13, the field and the knower of the field. Picture: a birth chart wheel, the light outside it
The gap between two thoughts. Wait for the next thought; notice the pause. Moon phases change, the sky does not. Yoga Sutra 1.2. Picture: thoughts come and go, the stillness stays
